title: Eternals
description: Adds various rpg like items and mechanics in order to  turn minecraft into my ideal game so if anyones interested in trying it out feel free to download :)
body:
## Warning: This project is in Alpha

Explore the world of minecraft with a completly new lens with new classes, races, weapons, bosses and custom dungeons.

Choose a race and class.
Raid a dungeon.
Level Up.
Gain better gear.
Raid harder dungeons.

Play with friends in parties or compete to see who is faster, stronger and more skilled all while discovering new areas and weapons and making new crazy builds whether it be to maximize speed and break the sound barrier or maximize damage reduction to become immortal. The choice is yours
